faq.question: Which fires is a Water Based Fire Extinguishers extinguisher for?

about: Water extinguishers are for Class A fires only — paper, wood, cloth and similar solids — and work by cooling. They are common in homes, offices, schools and warehouses.
Never use a water extinguisher on electrical, oil or flammable-liquid fires. Check the pressure and service date regularly.
